Built for training and sanctioned bouts, these gloves combine durability with the responsive feel serious competitors need to perform at their best.

items.name: Elite Heavy Punching Bag
items.description: El Elite Heavy Bag es perfecto para el entrenamiento, con un sistema de correa doble que proporciona un rendimiento más tranquilo que los sistemas de cadena tradicionales.
